title: Start from a geometric series
text: For $$|t|<1$$, $$\frac{1}{1+t^2}$$ is the sum of $${\left(-1\right)}^n t^{2n}$$. Integrating each term from $$0$$ to $$1$$ gives $$\frac{{\left(-1\right)}^n}{2n+1}$$.

title: Evaluate the integral
text: So the series equals the integral of $$\frac{1}{1+t^2}$$ from $$0$$ to $$1$$, which is $$arctan(1)-arctan(0)=\frac{\pi}{4}$$.
